title: Untrodden pathways in the study of partitions with parts separated by parity
summary: In this paper, we study a partition function with parts separated by parity from a family of partition functions introduced by Andrews in 2019. We first show that its generating function admit representation in terms of mock modular forms of weight $3/2$. We then initiate a study of smallest-part partition function analogues of partitions with parts separated by parity, which, to the best of our knowledge, has not previously been investigated in the literature.
